description: Five design-system presets for the Svelte 5 data grid, each a mapping of the system's tokens onto --sg-* custom properties with a light and a dark set. Drop a preset onto any wrapper and every grid inside picks it up; the active mode follows the page's data-theme attribute so flipping dark mode swaps every preset's tokens together, and a side panel shows the exact CSS to paste into your app.

faq.question: How do I make the grid match my design system?
faq.answer: Map your tokens onto the --sg-* properties on a wrapper: background, foreground, border, accent, header background, radius and font. The side panel shows the full list for each preset as a starting point.

faq.question: How does dark mode work per preset?
faq.answer: Each preset defines its tokens twice, once for light and once under [data-theme='dark']. The page attribute selects the set, so the grid follows the app's theme switch.

faq.question: Do I need the preset stylesheets from the package?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The built-in presets in @svgrid/grid/themes are convenient, but any CSS that sets the --sg-* properties on an ancestor works the same way.
